_comment: The Wave Ledger (Steve 2026-10-10): wave unlocks run on KILLS only — a per-wave, per-village, per-run point ledger, cumulative across player deaths. Kill = pointsPerKill. A kill executed with the monster's discovered counter = pointsPerCounterKill (mastery bonus; the counter convention lives in src/js/waveLedger.js — wave 1-2 monster defs carry counter data, the bonus is LIVE since 2026-10-10). Per monster-type cap perTypeCap stops farming one type: breadth, not throughput. barsPerWave = point thresholds the ledger for wave N must reach to unlock wave N+1 (the pacing dial Steve will turn). CALIBRATION 2026-10-11 (longsim wave lever): wave-2 bar 5->4 — measured 20 seeds x200d: the w2 bar was the binding constraint on wave 3 (4/20 reached, median fill day 58 vs the day-25 floor — the bar, not the floor, blocked); 4 still needs 2+ monster types (breadth preserved, perTypeCap=2 intact). Day floors: wave 2 needs wave2DayFloor, waves 3+ need dayFloor. Scale gates live in code (w4 regional, w5 national) — unchanged.
